listings.name: Shoprite Westridge
listings.current_description: Shoprite Westridge is a supermarket anchoring Westridge Shopping Centre on Wespoort Drive, Mitchells Plain, with in-store bakery, meat market and deli counters alongside groceries and everyday essentials.

listings.name: Sitari Health Shop
listings.current_description: Sitari Health Shop is a health and supplements shop in Sitari Village Centre stocking brands such as Solgar, Metagenics and Urban Vega alongside other natural health products.

listings.name: Sonder Cafe
listings.current_description: Sonder Café is a vintage-style coffee shop on Lower Main Road in Observatory serving New York-style boiled bagels, artisanal sourdough toasted sandwiches, smoothie bowls and cold-pressed juices.

listings.name: SPAR Fish Hoek
listings.current_description: SPAR Fish Hoek is a supermarket branch in the Valyland Centre on Recreation Road, Fish Hoek, offering groceries, fresh produce and everyday essentials to the surrounding community.

listings.name: Spur
listings.current_description: Spur is a South African family steakhouse chain serving steaks, ribs, burgers and Tex-Mex-inspired dishes; this branch, known as Indigo Spur, trades from Waterstone Village, Somerset West.

listings.name: St Vincent Clinic
listings.current_description: St Vincent Clinic is a public healthcare clinic operated by the Western Cape Government on St Vincent Drive in Belhar, part of the Tygerberg Eastern Health District.

listings.name: TAH Green Point
listings.current_description: TAH Green Point is a veterinary hospital on High Level Road offering routine and emergency animal care, including vaccinations, dental care, surgery, radiology and round-the-clock emergency treatment.

listings.name: TEARS Animal Rescue
listings.current_description: TEARS Animal Rescue, also known as The Emma Animal Rescue Society, is an animal welfare organisation in Sunnydale that rescues, cares for and rehomes cats and dogs.

listings.name: The Crazy Store
listings.current_description: The Crazy Store is a discount variety store in 3Arts Village, Plumstead, part of South Africa's largest discount variety chain and one of the centre's anchor tenants.

listings.name: The Fish Hoek Galley
listings.current_description: The Fish Hoek Galley is a seafood restaurant at Bayside on Fish Hoek Beach, serving grilled prawns, linefish and a seafood platter alongside classic fish and chips.

listings.name: The Happy Uncles
listings.current_description: The Happy Uncles is a halaal fine-dining restaurant in Salt River's Spice Yard on Voortrekker Road, offering four-, six- and eight-course tasting menus without pork or alcohol.

listings.name: The Raj
listings.current_description: The Raj is a long-running Indian restaurant on the Camps Bay Promenade, established in 1995, serving North Indian and Tandoori cuisine including seafood specialities, with ocean views.

listings.name: The Vet Store
listings.current_description: The Vet Store is a South African, vet-owned pet store inside Capricorn Square in Muizenberg, stocking pet food and accessories with staff trained as Veterinary Nutritional Advisors.

listings.name: ThreeZero
listings.current_description: ThreeZero is a boutique fitness studio in Cape Quarter, De Waterkant, built around a Technogym Biocircuit that delivers AI-personalised 30-minute full-body workouts with on-site qualified personal trainers.

listings.name: ULMA Packaging Systems
listings.current_description: ULMA Packaging Systems is part of the Spanish ULMA Group and supplies stainless steel and galvanised strapping, buckles, tensioning tools and clips from its Killarney Gardens office.

listings.name: Virgin Active
listings.current_description: Virgin Active Waterstone Village is a health club in Somerset West with a heated lap pool, sauna, steam room, group exercise classes and a supervised kids' club.

listings.name: Wembley Meat Market
listings.current_description: Wembley Meat Market is a butchery in the Wembley Building on Belgravia Road, Athlone, part of the Wembley Group of Companies, selling fresh and prepared meat products.

listings.name: Westpoint Properties
listings.current_description: Westpoint Properties is an estate agency and property development company on Carlton Close in Sunnydale, specialising in residential property sales in the Sun Valley and Noordhoek area.

listings.name: Zone Fitness Tokai
listings.current_description: Zone Fitness Tokai is a gym in Blue Route Mall, Tokai, part of the Zone Fitness chain, offering fitness equipment and group classes with extended weekday hours.

listings.name: A J North (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: A J North (Pty) Ltd is a South African manufacturer of toiletries and toothbrushes, producing a range of affordable beauty, haircare and household products for over 100 years.

listings.name: Akiya Sushi
listings.current_description: Akiya Sushi is a sushi and sashimi restaurant in Canal Walk Shopping Centre, Century City, also serving a range of Asian dishes including dim sum and Chinese specialities.

listings.name: American Swiss
listings.current_description: American Swiss is a national jewellery and watch retail chain, with this branch located on the lower concourse level of Golden Acre Shopping Centre in central Cape Town.

listings.name: Ashley's Family Restaurant
listings.current_description: Ashley's Family Restaurant is a long-standing family restaurant in Goodwood serving seafood, steaks, burgers, pasta, pizzas, ribs and chicken, with a carvery on Wednesday evenings and Sunday lunchtimes.

listings.name: Atlantic View Pharmacy
listings.current_description: Atlantic View Pharmacy is a family-oriented pharmacy at the Belzac Centre in Melkbosstrand, offering chronic medication management, a daily dispensary and medical aid acceptance for the local community.

listings.name: Authentic Aesthetics S.A
listings.current_description: Authentic Aesthetics S.A is a beauty and aesthetics salon on Ayrshire Street in Rondebosch East offering treatments such as laser hair removal and skin-lightening treatments by appointment.

listings.name: AVBOB Khayelitsha
listings.current_description: AVBOB Khayelitsha is a funeral parlour and insurance branch of the AVBOB Mutual Assurance Society, offering funeral policies and funeral services to the Ilitha Park community in Khayelitsha.

listings.name: Basilico Steenberg
listings.current_description: Basilico Steenberg is an Italian restaurant in Steenberg Village, Tokai, known for its wood-fired pizzas and a wine list featuring Constantia Valley labels alongside other South African wines.

listings.name: Bishop Lavis Secondary School
listings.current_description: Bishop Lavis Secondary School is a public secondary school at 57 Helderberg Road in Bishop Lavis, offering a holistic, learner-centred education alongside chess, rugby, netball and cross-country programmes.

listings.name: BOA Beauty Bar
listings.current_description: BOA Beauty Bar is a nail and beauty salon inside De Ville Centre in Durbanville, offering treatments including gel manicures and pedicures alongside a dedicated men's pamper package.

listings.name: Body 20 Studio
listings.current_description: Body 20 Studio is an EMS (electro-muscular stimulation) training studio inside De Ville Shopping Centre in Durbanville, offering coach-guided 20-minute workout sessions with weekly InBody body composition tracking.

listings.name: BP Wavecrest Motors
listings.current_description: BP Wavecrest Motors is a 24-hour fuel station on the corner of Dennegeur Avenue and Agulhas Street in Strandfontein Village, Cape Town, offering round-the-clock fuel and forecourt services.

listings.name: Bryan Capes Physiotherapy
listings.current_description: Bryan Capes Physiotherapy is a sport and spine physiotherapy practice at Panorama Healthcare Centre, offering dry needling and rehabilitation with a focus on sports injuries and neuro-musculoskeletal conditions.

listings.name: Cafe Extrablatt
listings.current_description: Cafe Extrablatt is a German-style all-day cafe on Main Road in Green Point, inside the Exhibition Building near DHL Stadium, known for its breakfast buffet, pizzas and hamburgers.

listings.name: Cafe Puka
listings.current_description: Cafe Puka is a neighbourhood coffee shop and restaurant on the corner of Brunswick and Tamboerskloof Roads, serving breakfast, lunch and coffee with both indoor and outdoor seating.

listings.name: Caltex Lansdowne Corner
listings.current_description: Caltex Lansdowne Corner is a FreshStop-branded Caltex fuel station in the Lansdowne Corner Shopping Centre, trading around the clock with a FreshStop convenience store alongside its fuel pumps.

listings.name: Cash Crusaders Avonwood
listings.current_description: Cash Crusaders Avonwood is a branch of the Cash Crusaders secondhand retail chain in Avonwood Square, Elsies River, buying and selling used electronics, appliances, tools and other goods.

listings.name: Cashbuild
listings.current_description: Cashbuild is a South African hardware and building materials retailer chain; its Delft Mall branch stocks building supplies, tools and home-improvement essentials for local trade and DIY customers.

listings.name: Cattle Baron Plattekloof
listings.current_description: Cattle Baron Plattekloof is a steakhouse in Plattekloof Shopping Centre that has served the area for more than 20 years, with a buffet offered on Wednesdays and Fridays.

listings.name: Cheyne's Restaurant
listings.current_description: Cheyne's Restaurant is an Asian-inspired eatery in Hout Bay serving Pacific Rim-influenced cuisine sourced from local suppliers, set around a Balinese-style garden used for both dining and cocktails.

listings.name: The Chiropractic Health Centre
listings.current_description: The Chiropractic Health Centre is a chiropractic practice on the 3rd floor of The Point in Sea Point, offering chiropractic consultations, biokinetics, massage therapy and foot care treatments.

listings.name: Citivet Gardens
listings.current_description: A veterinary clinic in Vredehoek offering full health checkups plus surgical and medical care with in-house hospital admission, and stocking prescription veterinary food ranges and other pet-care products.

listings.name: Clicks Golden Acre
listings.current_description: Clicks Golden Acre is a pharmacy and health, beauty and homeware store inside the Golden Acre shopping centre in central Cape Town, accessible from the Castle Street entrance.

listings.name: Clicks Longbeach Mall
listings.current_description: Clicks Longbeach Mall is a pharmacy and health, beauty and homeware store branch inside Longbeach Mall in Noordhoek, offering a pharmacy dispensary alongside health, beauty and household products.

listings.name: Clicks Pharmacy Edgemead
listings.current_description: Clicks Pharmacy Edgemead is a branch of the Clicks pharmacy, health and beauty retail chain in Edgemead Shopping Centre, combining a dispensary with health, beauty and toiletry products.

listings.name: Clicks Pharmacy Hout Bay
listings.current_description: Clicks Pharmacy Hout Bay is a branch of the Clicks pharmacy and health chain inside Mainstream Mall in Hout Bay, offering a dispensary and health and beauty retail.

listings.name: County Fair
listings.current_description: County Fair is an Astral Foods poultry brand producing fresh, frozen and value-added chicken products for the Western Cape market and beyond, operating from its Epping Industria site.

listings.name: Crown National Factory Mart Brackenfell Corner
listings.current_description: Crown National Factory Mart is a factory shop in Brackenfell Corner, Brackenfell, selling spices, herbs, seasonings, sauces and meat-processing supplies including packaging and casings for the food industry.

listings.name: De Abreu & Cohen Attorneys
listings.current_description: De Abreu & Cohen Attorneys is a law firm in Table View established in 1999, offering conveyancing, commercial law, general litigation, family law, wills, trusts and notarial services.

listings.name: Debonairs Pizza
listings.current_description: Debonairs Pizza in Avonwood Square is a pizza takeaway outlet of the national Debonairs Pizza chain, serving pizza, pasta, chicken wings, submarine sandwiches and desserts in Elsies River.

listings.name: Debonairs Pizza
listings.current_description: Debonairs Pizza in Victoria Mall, Grassy Park is a branch of the national pizza chain, offering dine-in, takeaway and delivery, including its Triple-Decker and Real Deal pizza ranges.
